_comment: PopTracker access rules per map, transcribed from the rules Justin supplied 2026-09-10.
Syntax is the pack's own: each string is one alternative (OR), commas inside it are AND.
A bare word is an item code, $Name is a logic.lua macro, @Path is another location.
An empty list means deliberately no gate - NOT 'not written yet'.
Where a cave listed 'recommended equipment', only the requirements that actually block
progress are gated (traversal, cold, air). Recommended-but-optional gear is left out on
purpose: over-gating a cave can make a seed unwinnable, under-gating only costs a hint.

artifacts._no_cave_tab_comment: Artifact spots in _caves that get NO tab (pin on the map only). Empty for now: Pit of Dreen (Devourer, open ocean, no cave) has a tab showing the user's in-game GPS screenshot 47.3/2.2 (user, 2026-11-17: keep a tab, use that screenshot).

_positions._source: ark.wiki.gg/wiki/Artifact_of_the_<Name>, ASE Ragnarok row, the ARTIFACT lat/lon (not the entrance). Fetched 2026-09-16.

_cave_pins._source: Pixel positions on the cave's own map image (poptracker_art/maps/<Map>_<Cave>.png). Life's Labyrinth: read off the artifact icons on the map Justin supplied 2026-11-10 (2000x1985 high-res version, ARK Patch 276; original in _source/maps/Ragnarok_Life_s_Labyrinth.jpg). The others: written by tools/cave_maps_to_poptracker.py from the /aptrail cave renders (build/caves/<cave>.json pins). Devourer: Pit of Dreen is no cave, its tab is the user's in-game GPS screenshot (_source/maps/Ragnarok_Pit_of_Dreen_gps.webp) with a title box; the pin sits in that box. A cave listed here gets one pin per artifact on its tab instead of one shared pin.

Dragon & Manticore._note: Both spawn together in one arena, so they are one tracker entry. per_member: one row per boss, any difficulty (user 2026-11-17: 'Kill Dragon(Any Difficulty) and Kill Manticore(Any Difficulty)'); boss kills are goal progress, not item checks.

attach._comment: Checks the pack has no section for, placed on an existing object. The pack already labels our VERY-HIGH checks 'High/Max Level Dino', so the true level-cap checks get a distinct label.

new_items._comment: Codes the rules above need that the pack has no item for. Ids are ours.

artifact_devious.name: Artifact - Devious
artifact_devious._note: no AP item: ticked by the Artifact: Devious check (8757409), like the other artifacts
